_description: Minimal appointment scenario — only the appointment date is populated; time and notes fall to defaults. Config includes the duration defaults. The target patient identifier and visit type are read from config.json (appointment.targetPatientIdentifier, appointment.visitType).

_config._comment_dynamicDateTime: Optional: override auto-generated values. Set to null or omit to use today/now defaults.
_config._comment_defaultDurationMinutes: Used to calculate endTime when startTime is provided but endTime is not (unless both are null).
